scope: Evidence reconciliation for Super Souls 155, 173, 175, 179, 187, 197, and evidence-boundary review of 032
evidence: Current maintained Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Super Soul catalogue for exact-name identity, trigger/effect/magnitude, Limit Burst, and acquisition endpoints.
Independent historical XV2 Super Soul stat-sheet evidence for numeric mechanics.
Independent Steam all-186-Parallel-Quests guide for exact PQ reward endpoints including PQ113 and the relevant PQ range.
Independent GameFAQs evidence for PQ acquisition and/or tested effect behavior.
Independent DLC/character pages for DLC grouping and character ownership where applicable.
Official Future Saga Chapter 4 DLC announcement plus independent community testing for Super Soul 032.

promoted_records.super-soul-155: Exact-name catalogue/stat-sheet/GameFAQs evidence corroborates Gohan (Future), below-50%-HP trigger, +10% Ki Auto-Recovery, -10% damage taken, Limit Burst, and PQ40 provenance.
promoted_records.super-soul-173: Exact-name catalogue/stat-sheet/Steam/GameFAQs evidence corroborates Piccolo identity, always-on +5% revival-time penalty and -5% damage taken, Limit Burst, and PQ105 provenance.
promoted_records.super-soul-175: Exact-name catalogue/stat-sheet evidence corroborates Vados identity, Just Guard trigger, +60 Ki/+20 Stamina, Auto Just Guard Limit Burst, and PQ106 provenance.
promoted_records.super-soul-179: Exact-name catalogue/stat-sheet/GameFAQs testing corroborates Goku Black (Super Saiyan Rosé), guard-break trigger, +50 Ki, guard-break recovery behavior, Limit Burst, and PQ109 provenance; community ~29–30% testing is not promoted over the documented -20% value.
promoted_records.super-soul-187: Exact-name catalogue/DLC/Steam/GameFAQs evidence corroborates Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed), max-Ki/max-Stamina triggers, +10% stamina recovery/+20% Ki Auto-Recovery, Limit Burst, and PQ113 provenance.
promoted_records.super-soul-197: Exact-name catalogue/DLC/GameFAQs/Steam evidence corroborates Fu identity, above-75%-HP trigger, Ki recovery/Ki Blast boost, Limit Burst, and PQ121 provenance.

evidence_boundary.super-soul-032: PQ185 acquisition is independently corroborated, but item-level mechanics remain secondary/community-tested. The current +20% all-abilities wording is retained with partially_verified status; no Limit Burst or engine-level timing details are invented.

limits: No canonical Super Soul→PQ relationship identities changed.
No reward probability, Ultimate-Finish requirement, engine-level timing, or undocumented stacking behavior was inferred.
Historical/community discrepancies remain documented rather than silently normalized.
